title: 卡特里娜飓风对新奥尔良的影响
desc: 卡特里娜飓风对新奥尔良的影响

paragraphs.en: The death of Big Freedia's brother Adam Ross marks the second fatal shooting in central city this month.
paragraphs.zh: 大弗雷迪亚的哥哥亚当·罗斯离世，这是本月市中心发生的第二起致命枪击案。

paragraphs.en: The shooting that took Ross's life on January 2018 spurred Big Freedia, a popular hip-hop musician in New Orleans, to address the vicious circle of violence, trauma and incarceration in her community.
paragraphs.zh: 2018年1月夺走罗斯生命的枪击事件，促使新奥尔良著名嘻哈音乐人大弗雷迪亚着手解决她所在社区暴力、创伤和监禁的恶性循环问题。

paragraphs.en: Yesterday, I lost a close friend of mine, and the day before that, I lost someone else that I know.
paragraphs.zh: 昨天我失去了一个好朋友，前一天我又失去了一个我认识的人。

paragraphs.en: So just every day on some kind of level we're losing people and it's just so sad and it's so heartbreaking.
paragraphs.zh: 从某种程度上来说，我们每天都在失去一些人，这真是令人难过，令人心碎。

paragraphs.en: She attributes this crisis to gun violence that leaves fatherless and motherless children to fend for themselves, a cycle of violence that continues as youngsters seek revenge for the killings of the parents and friends.
paragraphs.zh: 她把这场危机归咎于枪支暴力，这种暴力让失去双亲的孩子不得不自力更生，青少年为父母和朋友的遇害寻求报复，使得暴力持续不断。

paragraphs.en: At a middle school forum on gun violence, students are jaded by the violence and death around them.
paragraphs.zh: 在一场关于枪支暴力的中学论坛上，学生们对周围的暴力和死亡感到厌倦。

paragraphs.en: Go outside, they just be pop shooting for nothing like a bullet could hit anybody, a bullet don't got no name.
paragraphs.zh: 走在外面，他们就是无缘无故地胡乱开枪，子弹可能会击中任何人，子弹可不管会打中谁。

paragraphs.en: I was holding my daddy when he was dying slowly when he was wounded by a gun bullet.
paragraphs.zh: 我爸爸被一颗子弹击中后，在他慢慢死去的时候，我一直抱着他。

paragraphs.en: Trauma and criminal behavior often lead to incarceration. I got two charges: carjacking and possession of a weapon.
paragraphs.zh: 创伤和犯罪行为常常导致监禁。我面临两项指控：劫车和持有武器。

paragraphs.en: According to the CDC, Louisiana has the fifth highest number of gun-related deaths in the US.
paragraphs.zh: 根据疾控中心的数据，路易斯安那州与枪支相关的死亡人数在美国排名第五。

paragraphs.en: It also has one of the highest rates of incarceration in the nation, with one out of 100 Louisianians imprisoned.
paragraphs.zh: 它也是全国监禁率最高的州之一，每100名路易斯安那州居民中就有1人被监禁。

paragraphs.en: Of those there are four black prisoners for every white one.
paragraphs.zh: 其中黑人囚犯与白人囚犯之比为4：1。

paragraphs.en: We don't want to see y'all in here. How many people y'all think of be affected by the things that y'all do? Your whole family.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不想在这里见到你们。你们觉得你们的所作所为会影响到多少人呢？会影响到你们全家人。

paragraphs.en: It's the slave man talented. That's the problem. That's the heart of the problem.
paragraphs.zh: 有才华的是那些受压迫的人。这就是问题所在。这就是问题的核心。

paragraphs.en: We are inclined to do the things that we do because we don't feel like there's anything else we can do.
paragraphs.zh: 我们倾向于做那些我们正在做的事情，是因为我们觉得别无选择。

paragraphs.en: According to the documentary, Hurricane Katrina, which struck New Orleans 15 years ago, exacerbated crime and violence in the city by destroying the local economy and displacing some 400,000 residents.
paragraphs.zh: 根据纪录片所述，15年前袭击新奥尔良的飓风卡特里娜摧毁了当地经济，并使约40万居民流离失所，从而加剧了该市的犯罪与暴力问题。

paragraphs.en: It changed the dynamics of the city. It changed the neighborhoods. Whole neighborhoods were washed out.
paragraphs.zh: 它改变了城市的格局；它改变了社区的面貌。整个社区都被冲毁了。

paragraphs.en: And as people came trickling in, you know, they had lost their homes, they'd lost everything.
paragraphs.zh: 当人们陆续来到这里，他们已经失去了家园，失去了一切。

paragraphs.en: Post-Katrina destruction, displacement and crime in New Orleans is also the theme of the feature film drama, RZA's Cut Throat City.
paragraphs.zh: 卡特里娜飓风过后新奥尔良的破坏、居民流离失所和犯罪问题，也是罗伯特·菲茨杰拉德·迪格斯（RZA）执导的剧情长片《夺命城》的主题。

paragraphs.en: The film starts on a positive note with Blink, one of the main characters, a graphic novel artist dreaming for a better life.
paragraphs.zh: 电影以积极的基调开始，主角之一布林克是一位渴望更好生活的漫画艺术家。

paragraphs.en: But then Katrina strikes the Lower Ninth Ward, a low-income district and upends the life of Blink and his community.
paragraphs.zh: 但随后，卡特里娜飓风袭击了低收入社区下九区，打乱了布林克及其所在社区居民的生活。

paragraphs.en: Unable to get a job or get help from the Federal Emergency Management Agency, he turns to crime.
paragraphs.zh: 由于找不到工作，也得不到联邦紧急事务管理署的帮助，他走上了犯罪道路。

paragraphs.en: One heist leads to another, making it harder and harder for Blink to get out of a hopeless situation,
paragraphs.zh: 一个接一个的抢劫，让布林克越来越难以摆脱绝望的处境。

paragraphs.en: Hopelessness during post-Katrina New Orleans is RZA's theme.
paragraphs.zh: 卡特里娜飓风过后新奥尔良所弥漫的绝望感，正是RZA作品的核心主题。

paragraphs.en: The film also describes how corruption has been plaguing the city for generations.
paragraphs.zh: 这部电影还描述了腐败如何困扰这座城市数代人。

paragraphs.en: RZA's Cut Throat City appears to be a place where dreams of poverty-stricken African-Americans come to die.
paragraphs.zh: 《夺命城》似乎是贫困的非洲裔美国人梦想破灭的地方。

paragraphs.en: Still, the filmmaker says his film ends with the redemptive note that people have the power to turn their lives around.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，这位电影制作人表示，他的影片最终以救赎性的基调收尾，即人们有能力改变自己的生活。

paragraphs.en: The lotus flower grows out of mud. Okay, the community could be mud, but a flower could grow out of it.
paragraphs.zh: 莲出淤泥而不染。社区或许如同淤泥，但花朵也能从中绽放。

paragraphs.en: I think everyone deserves a second chance or at least should have the option.
paragraphs.zh: 我认为每个人都应该有第二次机会，或者至少应该有这个选择。

paragraphs.en: Katrina's always been with us, set a bunch of different names.
paragraphs.zh: 卡特里娜一直和我们在一起，只是冠以了各种不同的名称。
